# envvar 子命令
# 对应 envvar/envvar_test.go

# list
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar list scoped
stdout .

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar list app --app $BKMS_APP_ID
stdout .

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar list env --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME
stdout .

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar list app
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar list env
outcontains 'required'

# scoped CRUD
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar create scoped --key E2E_TEST_SCOPED_VAR --value test-value
stdout .

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar update scoped --key E2E_TEST_SCOPED_VAR --value updated-value
stdout .

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar delete scoped --key E2E_TEST_SCOPED_VAR
stdout .

# app CRUD
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar create app --app $BKMS_APP_ID --key E2E_TEST_APP_VAR --value test-value
stdout .

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar update app --app $BKMS_APP_ID --key E2E_TEST_APP_VAR --value updated-value
stdout .

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar delete app --app $BKMS_APP_ID --key E2E_TEST_APP_VAR
stdout .

# env CRUD
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar create env --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME --key E2E_TEST_ENV_VAR --value test-value
stdout .

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar update env --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME --key E2E_TEST_ENV_VAR --value updated-value
stdout .

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar delete env --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME --key E2E_TEST_ENV_VAR
stdout .

# export
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar export scoped
stdout .

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar export app --app $BKMS_APP_ID
stdout .

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar export env --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME
stdout .

# error cases
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar create scoped --value val
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar delete scoped
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN envvar delete scoped --key NONEXISTENT_KEY_E2E_XYZ
